metadata.question: Was more than 30 percent of Lake Okeechobee’s surface covered by cyanobacteria on June 12, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-2 surface reflectance (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) – 10 m resolution, includes quality band for cloud masking. - Date: single-day filter for 2023-06-12 ± a tiny window (1 day) to guarantee at least one tile, then pick the least-cloudy image. - Location: Lake Okeechobee in southern Florida (approximate centroid at −80.8°E, 26.8°N); use a concise polygon just inside the lake shore to avoid mixed pixels. 2. Masking strategy: - Clouds / cirrus / saturated bits in the Scene Classification Layer (SCL) – keep only pixels coded 4 (vegetation), 5 (bare soils), 6 (water) and 7 (unclassified) after visually checking that 6-cover-water dominates inside the lake. - No extra snow/topographic shadow mask needed for Florida in June. 3. Cyanobacteria proxy: Use the cyanobacteria index (Cya) of Matthews et al. (2012): Cya = B04⁻¹ − B02⁻¹ (i.e. 1/Red − 1/Blue) Higher values indicate high phycocyanin / cyanobacteria presence. Published threshold for “cyanobacteria bloom” presence in turbid lakes: Cya ≥ 0.005. 4. Calculation: - Count valid lake pixels after cloud masking. - Count pixels where Cya ≥ 0.005. - Fraction = bloom_pixels / valid_pixels. - If fraction > 0.30 → “Yes”, else → “No”. 5. Missing-data checks: - If collection .size() == 0 → C1. - If valid_pixels == 0 → C2. - If fraction result is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time lake = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-81.2,26.6],[-80.4,26.6],[-80.4,27.0],[-81.2,27.0]]) date = '2023-06-12' # 2. Image acquisition s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lake) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1,'day')) .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE') .first()) if s2 is None: print("Empty collection.") print("C1") # 3. Cloud/water mask (keep water & vegetated/bare) s2 = s2.updateMask(s2.select('SCL').gte(4).And(s2.select('SCL').lte(7))) # 4. Cyanobacteria index cya = s2.expression('1/B4 - 1/B2', {'B2':s2.select('B2'),'B4':s2.select('B4')}) # 5. Pixel counts total = cya.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lake, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo() bloom = cya.gte(0.005).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo() if total == 0: print("No valid lake pixels.") print("C2") elif bloom is None: print("Calculation failure.") print("C3") pct = bloom/total print(f"Valid pixels: {int(total)}, bloom pixels: {int(bloom)}, bloom %: {pct*100:.1f}") if pct > 0.30: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
lake = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[-81.2,26.6],[-80.4,26.6],[-80.4,27.0],[-81.2,27.0]])
date = '2023-06-12'

# 2. Image acquisition
s2 = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(lake)
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1,'day'))
        .sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE')
        .first())
if s2 is None:
    print("Empty collection.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Cloud/water mask (keep water & vegetated/bare)
s2 = s2.updateMask(s2.select('SCL').gte(4).And(s2.select('SCL').lte(7)))

# 4. Cyanobacteria index
cya = s2.expression('1/B4 - 1/B2', {'B2':s2.select('B2'),'B4':s2.select('B4')})

# 5. Pixel counts
total = cya.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=lake, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()
bloom = cya.gte(0.005).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=lake, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()

if total == 0:
    print("No valid lake pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif bloom is None:
    print("Calculation failure.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

pct = bloom/total
print(f"Valid pixels: {int(total)}, bloom pixels: {int(bloom)}, bloom %: {pct*100:.1f}")
if pct > 0.30:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
